title: Deep Reinforced Self-Attention Masks for Abstractive Summarization (DR.SAS)
abstract: We present a novel architectural scheme to tackle the abstractive summarization problem based on the CNN/DM dataset [1] which fuses Reinforcement Learning (RL) with UniLM, which is a pre-trained Deep Learning Model, to solve various natural language tasks. We have tested the limits of learning fine-grained attention in Transfomers [3] to improve the summarization quality. UniLM applies attention to the entire token space in a global fashion. We propose DR.SAS which applies the Actor Critic (AC) algorithm [2] to learn a dynamic self-attention distribution over the tokens to reduce redundancy and generate factual and coherent summaries to improve the quality of summarization. After performing hyperparameter tuning, we achieved better ROUGE results compared to the baseline. Our model tends to be more extractive/factual yet coherent in details because of optimization over ROUGE rewards. We present detailed error analysis with examples of strengths and limitations of our model. Our codebase will be publicly available on our github [20]
